title: Install fixture software as the test user
when: A dedicated QA host needs software installed or replaced
need: Use vendor public installers as the test user. Elevate at the vendor's normal prompt for a machine-wide dependency. Use Docker Desktop on supported Macs and keep its VM state live outside the golden. Apply the documented macOS 12 exceptions.
surface: Machine QA index and host provisioning procedures
review: Verify install scopes and fresh goldens on the reinstalled fleet.
